response.original_title: [FAQs-Support] How do I add a Passenger to my Freedom of the sea Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to your Royal Caribbean Freedom of the Seas cruise +1-866-254-7549, you must call customer service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your travel agent, because additions cannot be processed online +1-866-254-7549.Important Rules and Requirements Stateroom Capacity: Your cabin must have physical space (such as a sofa bed, upper Pullman, or third berth) to support an extra person +1-866-254-7549. If your room is at maximum capacity, you may need to upgrade to a larger stateroom +1-866-254-7549. Ship Capacity: The total number of passengers on board cannot exceed safety and lifeboat limits.Pricing: The new guest will be charged at current prevailing market rates for the cruise fare, port fees, and taxes, rather than your original booking price +1-866-254-7549.Timing: Make your changes before the ship's manifest is finalized, which is typically around 72 hours before sailing +1-866-254-7549.
